name: MediaPipe SqueezeNet Preprocessing Specification v1
pipeline_flow: 2. Detect hand landmarks using MediaPipe HandLandmarker (App/include50_model/hand_landmarker.task) with num_hands=2.
3. Compute combined 2D bounding box across all detected hands (combining all 42 landmarks if 2 hands).
4. Expand box isotropically to 1:1 square: side = round(max(bw, bh) * 1.30) (15% margin on all 4 sides).
5. Shift crop box deterministically if extending beyond frame boundaries without changing square size.
6. If square crop exceeds boundary after shift, pad with black pixels (cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT, value=0).
9. Rescale pixel values to [0.0, 1.0] by dividing float32 values by 255.0.
11. Feed into SqueezeNet classifier to obtain 26-class softmax probabilities.
